text:
Priya: Hey team — final call for ZenithMed private rollout. Proposed change window: Wed 2026-04-01 02:00–03:00 UTC. Need Dedicated capacity pinned to v1.18.3-quant, DB migration quiesce, and security sign-off. Can we lock?
Alex: Roger. Release lead here — I can drive. Plan is 10% canary for 30m -> ramp to 100% if metrics look good. Who's running the canary?
Maya: SRE — I'll run the canary and dashboards. Two notes: 1) prefix cache warmup script must run pre-cutover (see snippet below). 2) Fallback route needs to point to m-legacy when error >2%.
Maya: ```sh
# warmup script
python tools/warmup_kv_cache.py --tenants zenithmed --parallel=8
```
Carlos: CS: ZenithMed prefers minimal downtime. They've agreed to read-only during the DB migration but only for up to 20 minutes. We need a 30m prior notification.
Ben: Security — I need to complete KMS rotation and post audit evidence before I can approve. If rotation done, I can approve the rollout.
Sam: Ops — Rollback plan: keep previous model pinned and traffic-routing toggle ready in the console. Auto-fallback rule: if error_rate > 2% for 5m, flip to legacy and alert oncall. I'll be on-call for the window.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: ZenithMed private rollout requested by Priya. Window: 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z. Status: pending approvals (security, cs).
Priya: Added Ben's KMS rotation as a blocker. @Carlos confirming read-only ok?
Carlos: Confirmed — ZenithMed agreed to read-only for up to 20 minutes and wants a notification 30m prior. I'll coordinate customer comms.
Alex: I'll put a pre-deploy notification at 01:30 UTC and prepare a manual rollback button. Who's oncall infra the night before?
Maya: oncall: Maya. I'll monitor the canary dashboards and run the warmup. Also suggesting the hotfix tag: `patch/fix-kv-warmup` be included with the pin.
Priya: Product approves the window conditional on security rotation. @Ben please confirm KMS rotation by EOD Fri (2026-03-27).
Ben: Confirmed — rotation scheduled 2026-03-27 09:00 UTC. I'll drop the rotation audit log here once it's complete.
deploy-bot: Approval update: security-approved: false; cs-approved: true; pending: security.
Sam: Ops checklist: rollback doc https://redwood.internal/runbooks/zenithmed-rollback (allowlist updated, infra toggle documented).
Alex: Locking tentatively. Once Ben posts rotation confirmation I'll flip to approved and schedule the manual canary start.
Priya: Thanks — @deploy-bot, schedule tentative canary at 02:00 but DO NOT execute until Alex gives manual go.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-01T02:00Z (manual start).
Priya: Marking thread as awaiting security rotation. I'll follow up in #eng-releases Friday morning with the audit. :thumbsup:
